culprit_citations.quoted_text: ATS (5)(17) | First Lien Senior Secured Loan - Revolver | principal -- | cost -- | market value --

findings.detail: B01 treats source-reported dash market values on zero or unfunded investment leaves as missing fair values.

rationale: Class 3 anchor-first review. The filing schedule reports market values on funded positions and an Investments Total market value of $1,815,082 thousand, but the ATS revolver leaf explicitly uses dashes for principal, cost, and market value. The extract's 751/840 nonblank rate therefore counts legitimate source-reported zero/unfunded leaves as completeness defects. B01 needs to exclude such leaves or treat source dashes as zero; the flagged aggregate is a false alarm, not evidence of missing extraction.
